verses.uthmani: يسٓ
verses.indopak: يٰسٓ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Yaa-Seeen
verses.saheeh: Ya, Seen.
verses.khattab: Yâ-Sĩn
verses.jalalayn: Yā sīn: God knows best what He means by these [letters].
verses.romanUrdu: Yasin

verses.uthmani: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.indopak: وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wal-Qur-aanil-Hakeem
verses.saheeh: By the wise Qur'an.
verses.khattab: By the Quran, rich in wisdom
verses.jalalayn: By the Definitive Qur'an, made definitive by its marvellous arrangement and unique meanings,
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai Quran e Hakeem ki

verses.uthmani: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Innaka laminal mursaleen
verses.saheeh: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
verses.khattab: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers
verses.jalalayn: you, O Muhammad (s), are indeed of those sent [by God],
verses.romanUrdu: Ke tum yaqeenan Rasoolon mein se ho

verses.uthmani: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.indopak: عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: 'Alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
verses.saheeh: On a straight path.
verses.khattab: upon the Straight Path
verses.jalalayn: on a (‘alā is semantically connected to the preceding [statement]) straight path, that is, [you follow] the way of the prophets before you, [enjoining] the affirmation of God’s Oneness and guidance (the emphasis expressed by the oath [in ‘by the definitive Qur'an’] and the remainder [of the statement] is a response to the disbelievers’ saying to him, ‘You have not been sent [by God]!’ [Q. 13:43].
verses.romanUrdu: Seedhey raastey par ho

verses.uthmani: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.indopak: تَنۡزِيۡلَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الرَّحِيۡمِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Tanzeelal 'Azeezir Raheem
verses.saheeh: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.khattab: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: A revelation from the Mighty, in His kingdom, the Merciful, to His creatures (tanzīla’l-‘azīzi’l-rahīm is the predicate of an implicit subject, namely, qur'an),
verses.romanUrdu: (Aur yeh Quran) gaalib aur Raheem hasti ka nazil karda hai

verses.uthmani: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.indopak: لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّاۤ اُنۡذِرَ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Litunzira qawmam maaa unzira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon
verses.saheeh: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
verses.khattab: so that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so are heedless
verses.jalalayn: that you may warn, therewith, a people (qawman, connected to tanzīla, ‘a revelation’) whose fathers were not warned, in the period of the interval (al-fatra), so they, this people, are oblivious, to faith and right guidance.
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke tum khabardar karo ek aisi qaum ko jiske baap dada khabardar na kiye gaye thay aur is wajah se woh gaflat mein padey huey hain

verses.uthmani: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلٰٓى اَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon
verses.saheeh: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
verses.khattab: The decree ˹of torment˺ has already been justified against most of them, for they will never believe
verses.jalalayn: The word, for chastisement, has already proved true, it has become due, for most of them, for they, in other words, most of them, will not believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Inmein se aksar log faisla-e-azaab ke mustahiq ho chuke hain, isi liye woh iman nahin latey

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِىۡۤ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ اَغۡلٰلًا فَهِىَ اِلَى الۡاَ ذۡقَانِ فَهُمۡ مُّقۡمَحُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal azqaani fahum muqmahoon
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
verses.khattab: ˹It is as if˺ We have put shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up
verses.jalalayn: Indeed We have put fetters around their necks, to bind to them their hands (because ghull [is a fetter that] shackles the hands to the neck), such that they, the hands, are, bound, up to the chins (adhqān is the plural of dhaqan, which is where the two sides of the beard meet) so that their heads are upturned, they are unable to lower them: this [statement] is figurative and is meant to indicate their inability to yield to faith or to lower their heads to it.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne unki gardano mein tauq (bedi /fetters) daal diye hain jinse woh thodiyon (chins) tak jakade gaye hain, isliye woh sar uthaye khade hain

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ سَدًّا وَّمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدًّا فَاَغۡشَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw-wa min khalfihim saddan fa aghshai naahum fahum laa yubsiroon
verses.saheeh: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
verses.khattab: and have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them ˹all˺ up, so they fail to see ˹the truth˺
verses.jalalayn: And We have set before them a barrier (read saddan or suddan in both instances) and behind them a barrier; so We have covered them, so they do not see — this is also figurative, depicting the way in which the paths of faith are closed to them.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne ek deewar unke aagey khadi kardi hai aur ek deewar unke peechey, humne unhein dhaank diya hai, unhein ab kuch nahin soojhta

verses.uthmani: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَهُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
verses.saheeh: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
verses.khattab: It is the same whether you warn them or not—they will never believe
verses.jalalayn: And it is the same to them whether you warn them (read a-andhartuhum, pronouncing both hamzas; or by substituting an alif for the second one; or by not pronouncing the second one but inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the other one, or without [the insertion]) or do not warn them, they will not believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Unke liye yaksan hai, tum unhein khabardar karo ya na karo, yeh na maanengey

verses.uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.indopak: اِنَّمَا تُنۡذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِىَ الرَّحۡمٰنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِ ۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّاَجۡرٍ كَرِيۡمٍ
verses.transliteration: Innamaa tunziru manit taba 'az-Zikra wa khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem
verses.saheeh: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
verses.khattab: You can only warn those who follow the Reminder and are in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing Him. So give them good news of forgiveness and an honourable reward
verses.jalalayn: You can only warn, in other words, your warning will only benefit, him who follows the Remembrance, the Qur'an, and fears the Compassionate One in secret, who fears Him despite not having seen Him; so give him the good tidings of forgiveness and a noble reward, namely, Paradise.
verses.romanUrdu: Tum to usi shaks ko khabardar kar sakte ho jo naseehat ki pairvi karey aur bay-dekhe khuda e rehman se darey, usey magfirat aur ajr-e-karim ki basharat (khush khabri) de do

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡىِ الۡمَوۡتٰى وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوۡا وَاٰثَارَهُمۡ ؕ وَكُلَّ شَىۡءٍ اَحۡصَيۡنٰهُ فِىۡۤ اِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa wa naktubu maa qaddamoo wa aasaarahum; wa kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen
verses.saheeh: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
verses.khattab: It is certainly We Who resurrect the dead, and write what they send forth and what they leave behind. Everything is listed by Us in a perfect Record
verses.jalalayn: Truly it is We Who bring the dead to life, for the resurrection, and record, in the Preserved Tablet, what they have sent ahead, during their lives, of good or evil, that they may be requited for it, and their vestiges, what conduct was followed after them as good practice. And everything (kulla shay’in is in the accusative because of the verb that governs it [and is the following]) We have numbered, We have recorded precisely, in a clear register, a clear Book, namely, the Preserved Tablet.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum yaqeenan ek roz murdon ko zinda karne waley hain jo kuch afaal (aamal) unhon ne kiye hain woh sab hum likhte rahey hain, aur jo kuch aasaar unhon ne peechey chodhey hain woh bhi hum sabt (likh) rahey hain. Har cheez ko humne ek khuli kitaab mein darj kar rakkha hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلًا اَصۡحٰبَ الۡقَرۡيَةِ ۘ اِذۡ جَآءَهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; iz jaaa'ahal mursaloon
verses.saheeh: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
verses.khattab: Give them an example ˹O Prophet˺ of the residents of a town, when the messengers came to them
verses.jalalayn: And strike for them as a similitude (mathalan is the first direct object) the inhabitants (ashāba is the second direct object) of the town, [of] Antioch (Antākya), when the messengers, namely, Jesus’s disciples, came to it (idh jā’ahā’l-mursalūna is an inclusive substitution for ashāba’l-qaryati, ‘the inhabitants of the town’).
verses.romanUrdu: Inhein misaal ke taur par us basti walon ka qissa sunao jabke usmein Rasool aaye thay

verses.uthmani: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verses.indopak: اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِمُ اثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مُّرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Iz arsalnaaa ilaihimusnaini fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon
verses.saheeh: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
verses.khattab: We sent them two messengers, but they rejected both. So We reinforced ˹the two˺ with a third, and they declared, “We have indeed been sent to you ˹as messengers˺.”
verses.jalalayn: When We sent to them two men, and they denied them both (from idh arsalnā ilayhim ithnayni fa-kadhdhabūhumā to the end is a substitution for the previous idh, ‘when’), so We reinforced [them] (read fa-‘azaznā or fa-‘azzaznā, in other words, We reinforced the two men) with a third, and they said, ‘We have indeed been sent to you [by God]’.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne unki taraf do Rasool bheje aur unhon ne dono ko jhutla diya phir humne teesra madad ke liye bheja aur unsab ne kaha “Hum tumhari taraf Rasool ki haisiyat se bheje gaye hain”

wbw.translation: but they denied both of them

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا مَاۤ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُـنَا ۙ وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ ۙ اِنۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا تَكۡذِبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa wa maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takziboon
verses.saheeh: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
verses.khattab: The people replied, “You are only humans like us, and the Most Compassionate has not revealed anything. You are simply lying!”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘You are nothing but humans like us, and the Compassionate One has revealed nothing. You are only lying!’
verses.romanUrdu: Basti walon ne kaha “ tum kuch nahin ho magar hum jaise chandh Insaan, aur khuda e rehman ne hargiz koi cheez nazil nahin ki hai, tum mehaz jhoot boltey ho.”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ اِنَّاۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon
verses.saheeh: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
verses.khattab: The messengers responded, “Our Lord knows that we have truly been sent to you
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘Our Lord knows (qālū rabbunā ya‘lamu functions like an oath. Emphasis is intensified by this [oath] and also by the [addition of the] lām to what was before [simply, mursalūna, ‘we have been sent’] to counter their intensified denial) that we have indeed been sent to you [by Him]!
verses.romanUrdu: Rasoolon ne kaha “ hamara Rubb jaanta hai ke hum zarooor tumhari taraf Rasool bana kar bheje gaye hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.indopak: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَاۤ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen
verses.saheeh: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
verses.khattab: And our duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.”
verses.jalalayn: And our duty is only to communicate in clear terms’, to deliver the Message clearly and manifestly with plain proofs, such as the curing of the blind, the leper and the diseased and the bringing of the dead back to life.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humpar saaf saaf paigham pahuncha dene ke siwa koi zimmedari nahin hai”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.indopak: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡ ۚ لَٮِٕنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهُوۡا لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il-lam tantahoo lanar jumannakum wa la-yamassan nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem
verses.saheeh: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
verses.khattab: The people replied, “We definitely see you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you ˹to death˺ and you will be touched with a painful punishment from us.”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘We augur ill of you, for we have been deprived of rain because of you. If (la-in: the lām is for oaths) you do not desist, we will surely stone you and there shall befall you, at our hands, a painful chastisement’.
verses.romanUrdu: Basti waley kehne lagey “hum to tumhein apne liye faal-e-badd (manhoos) samajhte hain , agar tum baaz na aaye to hum tumko sangsaar(stoning) kar dengey aur humse tum badi dardnaak saza paogey”

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا طٰۤٮِٕـرُكُمۡ مَّعَكُمۡ ؕ اَٮِٕنۡ ذُكِّرۡتُمۡ ؕ بَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّسۡرِفُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon
verses.saheeh: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
verses.khattab: The messengers said, “Your bad omen lies within yourselves. Are you saying this because you are reminded ˹of the truth˺? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”
verses.jalalayn: They said, ‘May your augury of ill be with you!, [as punishment] for your disbelief. What! [Even] if (a-in: the interrogative hamza has been added to the conditional in, ‘if’, the hamza may be pronounced or elided, but in both cases add an alif between it and the other one) [it be that] you are being reminded?, [even if] you are being admonished and made to fear [God’s chastisement]? (the response to the conditional has been omitted, that is to say, ‘do you augur ill and disbelieve [even if it be that you are being admonished]?’ and this [response] constitutes the object of the interrogative, which is meant [rhetorically] as a rebuke). Nay, but you are a profligate people!’, who transgressing the bounds [set by God] with your [practice of] idolatry.
verses.romanUrdu: Rasoolon ne jawab diya “tumhari faal-e-badd (nahusat) to tumhare apne saath lagi hui hai , kya yeh baatein tum isliye karte ho ke tumhein naseehat ki gayi? Asal baat yeh hai ke tum hadd se guzre huey log ho”

verses.uthmani: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ رَجُلٌ يَّسۡعٰى قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوا الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluny yas'aa qaala yaa qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen
verses.saheeh: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
verses.khattab: Then from the farthest end of the city a man came, rushing. He advised, “O my people! Follow the messengers
verses.jalalayn: And there came a man from the furthest part of the city — this was Habīb the carpenter, who had believed in these messengers and whose house lay at the far end of the city — hastening, with a hurried pace, after he had heard that the people had denied the messengers. He said, ‘O my people, follow the messengers!
verses.romanUrdu: Itne mein shehar ke door daraaz goshey se ek shaks daudta hua aaya aur bola “Aey meri qaum ke logon, Rasoolon ki pairwi ikhtiyar karlo

verses.uthmani: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: اتَّبِعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّا يَسۡـــَٔلُكُمۡ اَجۡرًا وَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon
verses.saheeh: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
verses.khattab: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and are ˹rightly˺ guided
verses.jalalayn: Follow (ittabi‘ū, this reiterates the preceding [ittabi‘ū]) them who do not ask you for any reward, in return for [delivering to you] the message, and who are rightly guided. And so he was asked, ‘Do you follow their religion?’ So he replied:
verses.romanUrdu: Pairwi karo un logon ki jo tumse koi ajar nahin chahte aur theek raaste par hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا لِىَ لَاۤ اَعۡبُدُ الَّذِىۡ فَطَرَنِىۡ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon
verses.saheeh: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
verses.khattab: And why should I not worship the One Who has originated me, and to Whom you will be returned
verses.jalalayn: And why should I not worship Him Who originated me, [Him Who] created me — in other words: there is nothing to prevent me from worshipping Him when the necessitating factors for this exist, and the same applies to you — and to Whom you shall be returned?, after death, whereupon He will requite you for your disbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir kyun na main us hasti ki bandagi karoon jisne mujhey paida kiya hai aur jiski taraf tum sabko palat kar jana hai

verses.uthmani: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
verses.indopak: ءَاَ تَّخِذُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً اِنۡ يُّرِدۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّىۡ شَفَاعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـــًٔا وَّلَا يُنۡقِذُوۡنِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: 'A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon
verses.saheeh: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
verses.khattab: How could I take besides Him other gods whose intercession would not be of any benefit to me, nor could they save me if the Most Compassionate intended to harm me
verses.jalalayn: Shall I take (a-attakhidu: regarding the two hamzas here, the same applies as mentioned with regard to a-andhartuhum above; this is an interrogative meant as a denial) besides Him, in other words, other than Him, [other] gods, idols, whose intercession, [that intercession of theirs] which you assert, if the Compassionate One should wish me any harm, will not avail me in any way, nor will they [be able to] save me? (wa-lā yunqidhūn is an adjectival qualification of ālihatan, ‘gods’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya main usey chodh kar dusre ko mabood bana loon? Halaanke agar khuda e Rehman mujhey koi nuksaan pahunchana chahe to na unki shafaat mere kisi kaam aa sakti hai aur na woh mujhey chuda hi sakte hain

verses.uthmani: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.indopak: اِنِّىۡۤ اِذًا لَّفِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen
verses.saheeh: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
verses.khattab: Indeed, I would then be clearly astray
verses.jalalayn: Truly then, in other words, in the case of me worshipping [gods] other than God, I would be in manifest error.
verses.romanUrdu: Agar main aisa karoon to main sareeh gumraahi mein mubtala ho jaunga

verses.uthmani: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
verses.indopak: اِنِّىۡۤ اٰمَنۡتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَاسۡمَعُوۡنِ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon
verses.saheeh: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
verses.khattab: I do believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”
verses.jalalayn: Lo! I believe in your Lord. So listen to me!’, in other words, hear what I have to say; but they stoned him and he died.
verses.romanUrdu: Main to tumhare Rubb par iman le aaya, tum bhi meri baat maan lo.”

verses.uthmani: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: قِيۡلَ ادۡخُلِ الۡجَـنَّةَ ؕ قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِىۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon
verses.saheeh: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
verses.khattab: ˹But they killed him, then˺ he was told ˹by the angels˺, “Enter Paradise!” He said, “If only my people knew
verses.jalalayn: It was said, to him upon his death: ‘Enter Paradise!’ — but it is also said that he entered it while he was [still] alive. He said, ‘O (yā is for calling attention [to something]), would that my people knew
verses.romanUrdu: (aakhir e kaar un logon ne usey qatal kardiya aur) us shaks se kehdiya gaya ke “daakhil ho ja jannat mein” usne kaha “kaash meri qaum ko maaloom hota

verses.uthmani: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.indopak: بِمَا غَفَرَلِىۡ رَبِّىۡ وَجَعَلَنِىۡ مِنَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen
verses.saheeh: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
verses.khattab: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honourable.”
verses.jalalayn: with what [munificence] my Lord has forgiven me, [would that they knew] of His great forgiveness, and made me of the honoured ones!’
verses.romanUrdu: Ke mere Rubb ne kis cheez ki badaulat meri magfirat farma di aur mujhey ba-izzat logon mein daakhil farmaya”

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهٖ مِنۡ جُنۡدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُـنَّا مُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen
verses.saheeh: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
verses.khattab: We did not send any soldiers from the heavens against his people after his death, nor did We need to
verses.jalalayn: And We did not send (mā here is for negation) down on his people, namely, Habīb’s, after him, after his death, any host from the heaven, that is, any angels to destroy them, nor do We [ever] send down, any angels to destroy anyone.
verses.romanUrdu: Iske baad uski qaum par humne aasmaan se koi lashkar nahin utara , humein lashkar bhejne ki koi haajat na thi

verses.uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ خٰمِدُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon
verses.saheeh: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
verses.khattab: All it took was one ˹mighty˺ blast, and they were extinguished at once
verses.jalalayn: It, their punishment, was but one Cry — Gabriel gave a cry to them — and lo! they were extinguished, silent, dead.
verses.romanUrdu: Bas ek dhamaka hua aur yakayak woh sab bujh kar reh gaye

verses.uthmani: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.indopak: يٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى الۡعِبَادِ ؔ ۚ مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon
verses.saheeh: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.khattab: Oh pity, such beings! No messenger ever came to them without being mocked
verses.jalalayn: Ah, the anguish for servants, [such as] these and their like from among those who denied the messengers and were destroyed (this [word, hasra] denotes ‘extreme agony’; the vocative here is being used metaphorically, in other words, ‘It is time for you [O anguish], so come now!’). Never did a messenger come to them but that they mocked him (this [statement] is given as an explanation of the cause thereof [of the ‘agony’] since it [the statement] entails their mockery which itself results in their being destroyed and which in turn is the cause of the ‘anguish’).
verses.romanUrdu: Afsos bandon ke haal par, jo Rasool bhi unke paas aaya uska woh mazaaq hi udatey rahey

verses.uthmani: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَمۡ اَهۡلَـكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon
verses.saheeh: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
verses.khattab: Have the deniers not considered how many peoples We destroyed before them who never came back to life again
verses.jalalayn: Have they — that is, those inhabitants of Mecca who said to the Prophet, ‘You have not been sent [by God]!’ [Q. 13:43] — not seen, [not] come to know (the interrogative is meant [rhetorically] as an affirmative) how many (kam here is predicative [as opposed to interrogative], in other words [it is to be understood as] kathīran, ‘many’; it is operated by the statement that comes next [below] and it comments on the operative clause for the statement that preceded it); the meaning then is as follows: indeed, many, generations, communities, We have destroyed before them, [how] that they, the ones destroyed, never return?, to those deniers [who are now alive]? So will they not learn from their example? (from annahum, ‘[how] that they’, to the end [of the verse] is a substitution for the preceding clause [kam ahlaknā qablahum mina’l-qurūni], bearing in mind the aforementioned general meaning).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya unhon ne dekha nahin ke unsey pehle kitni hi qaumon ko hum halaak kar chuke hain aur iske baad woh phir kabhi unki taraf palat kar na aaye

verses.uthmani: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنۡ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon
verses.saheeh: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
verses.khattab: Yet they will all be brought before Us
verses.jalalayn: And indeed (in, is either for negation or is in its softened form) every one of them, that is, every single creature (kullun is the subject) will be gathered (jamī‘un is the predicate of the subject) before Us, at the Scene, following their resurrection, arraigned (muhdarūna is a second predicate) for the Reckoning (read lammā with the sense of illā, or lamā with the lām functioning as a separator and the mā being extra).
verses.romanUrdu: Un sab ko ek roz hamare saamne haazir kiya jaana hai

verses.uthmani: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الۡاَرۡضُ الۡمَيۡتَةُ ۖ ۚ اَحۡيَيۡنٰهَا وَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبًّا فَمِنۡهُ يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon
verses.saheeh: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
verses.khattab: There is a sign for them in the dead earth: We give it life, producing grain from it for them to eat
verses.jalalayn: And a sign for them, of the [truth of] resurrection (wa-āyatun lahum is a preceding predicate) is the dead earth (read maytatu or mayyitatu) which We revive, with water (ahyaynāhā is the subject) and out of which We bring forth grain, such as wheat, so that they eat thereof;
verses.romanUrdu: In logon ke liye be-jaan zameen ek nishani hai, humne isko zindagi bakshi aur issey galla (anaaj / grain) nikala jisey yeh khaate hain

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡعُيُوۡنِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon
verses.saheeh: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
verses.khattab: And We have placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth in it
verses.jalalayn: and We have placed therein gardens, orchards, of date-palms and vines, and We have caused, a number of, springs to gush forth therein,
verses.romanUrdu: Humne ismein khajuron aur angooron ke baagh paida kiye aur uske andar chashme (springs) phodh nikale

wbw.translation: and We caused to gush forth

verses.uthmani: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.indopak: لِيَاۡكُلُوۡا مِنۡ ثَمَرِهٖ ۙ وَمَا عَمِلَـتۡهُ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ ؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon
verses.saheeh: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
verses.khattab: so that they may eat from its fruit, which they had no hand in making. Will they not then give thanks
verses.jalalayn: that they might eat of its fruits (read thamarihi or thumurihi) in other words, [of] the fruits of the mentioned date-palms and otherwise; but it was not their hands that made it, namely, they did not cultivate the fruits. Will they not then give thanks?, for His favours to them, exalted be He?
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke yeh uske phal khayein, yeh sab kuch inke apne haathon ka paida kiya hua nahin hai phir kya yeh shukar ada nahin karte

verses.uthmani: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۡۢبِتُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
verses.saheeh: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
verses.khattab: Glory be to the One Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs—˹be it˺ what the earth produces, their genders, or what they do not know
verses.jalalayn: Glory be to Him Who created all the pairs, the specimens, of what the earth produces, of seeds and other things, and of themselves, of males and females, and of what they do not know, of marvellous and strange creatures.
verses.romanUrdu: Paak hai woh zaat jisne jumla aqsaam ke joday paida kiye khwah woh zameen ki nabataat mein se hon ya khud inki apni jins (yani naw-e-Insani) mein se ya un ashyah mein se jinko yeh jaante tak nahin hain

verses.uthmani: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّيۡلُ ۖ ۚ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مُّظۡلِمُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon
verses.saheeh: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
verses.khattab: There is also a sign for them in the night: We strip from it daylight, then—behold!—they are in darkness
verses.jalalayn: And a sign for them, of the tremendous power [of God], is the night, from which We strip, We separate, the day and, behold, they find themselves in darkness, passing into the darkness [of the night].
verses.romanUrdu: Inke liye ek aur nishani raat hai, hum uske upar se din hata dete hain to inpar andhera chaa jata hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.indopak: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِىۡ لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيۡرُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem
verses.saheeh: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.khattab: The sun travels for its fixed term. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing
verses.jalalayn: And the sun [which] runs (from wa’l-shamsu tajrī to the end [of the statement] is subsumed by [the introductory] wa-āyatun lahum, ‘and a sign for them’; alternatively, it constitutes another sign [for them]; similar is the case with wa’l-qamara, ‘and the moon’ [further below]) to its resting-place, in other words, it does not overstep it. That, namely, its running, is the ordaining of the Mighty, in His kingdom, the Knower, of His creation.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Suraj, woh apne thikane ki taraf chala ja raha hai, yeh zabardat aleem(All-Knowing) hasti ka bandha hua hisaab hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
verses.indopak: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰى عَادَ كَالۡعُرۡجُوۡنِ الۡقَدِيۡمِ
verses.transliteration: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem
verses.saheeh: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
verses.khattab: As for the moon, We have ordained ˹precise˺ phases for it, until it ends up like an old, curved palm stalk
verses.jalalayn: And the moon — (read wa’l-qamaru, in the nominative, or wa’l-qamara, in the accusative; and it may be in the accusative because of a following verb that governs it) We have determined it, with respect to its course, [to run] in phases — twenty eight phases in twenty eight nights of every month; it becomes concealed for two nights when the month has thirty days, and for one night when it has twenty nine days — until it returns, during its final phase seeming to the [human] eye, like an aged palm-bough, in other words, like the stalk with a date cluster when it ages, becoming delicate, arched and yellowish.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur chand, uske liye humne manzilein muqarrar kardi hain yahan tak ke insey guzarta hua woh phir khajur ki sukhi shaakh (dry old branch) ke manind reh jata hai

verses.uthmani: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا الشَّمۡسُ يَنۡۢبَغِىۡ لَهَاۤ اَنۡ تُدۡرِكَ الۡقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ ؕ وَكُلٌّ فِىۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon
verses.saheeh: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
verses.khattab: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor does the night outrun the day. Each is travelling in an orbit of their own
verses.jalalayn: It does not behove — it is [neither] facilitated nor is it right for — the sun to catch up with the moon, and so appear together with it at night, nor may the night outrun the day, and thus it [the night] never arrives before the latter ends and each (kullun: the nunation compensates for the [missing] genitive annexation [that would have been constructed] with al-shams, ‘the sun’, al-qamar, ‘the moon’, and al-nujūm, ‘the stars’) [of these] is in an orbit, swimming, moving — these [celestial bodies] are being treated as [though they were] rational beings.
verses.romanUrdu: Na Suraj ke bas mein yeh hai ke woh chand ko ja pakde aur na raat din par sabqat le ja sakti hai. Sab ek ek falak mein tair rahey hain

verses.uthmani: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.indopak: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمۡ اَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِى الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon
verses.saheeh: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
verses.khattab: Another sign for them is that We carried their ancestors ˹with Noah˺ in the fully loaded Ark
verses.jalalayn: And a sign for them, of Our power, is that We carried their seed (dhurriyatahum: a variant reading has dhurriyyātihim), that is to say, their original ancestors, in the laden Ark, that is, Noah’s fully-loaded ship,
verses.romanUrdu: Inke liye yeh bhi ek nishani hai ke humne inki nasal ko bhari hui kashti mein sawaar kardiya

verses.uthmani: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
verses.indopak: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖ مَا يَرۡكَبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon
verses.saheeh: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
verses.khattab: and created for them similar things to ride in
verses.jalalayn: and We have created for them the like of it, that is, the like of Noah’s Ark, namely, the small and large ships resembling it which they have made, by the instruction of God, exalted be He, in which they ride.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur phir inke liye waisi hi kashtiyan aur paida ki jinpar yeh sawaar hotay hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيۡخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡقَذُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon
verses.saheeh: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
verses.khattab: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—
verses.jalalayn: And if We will, We drown them, despite the existence of ships [for them to ride safely in], whereat they have no one to call to, [none] to succour [them], nor are they rescued, delivered —
verses.romanUrdu: Hum chahein to inko garq kardein, koi inki fariyad sunne wala na ho aur kisi tarah yeh na bachaye jaa sakein

wbw.translation: (would be) a responder to a cry

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen
verses.saheeh: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
verses.khattab: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while
verses.jalalayn: except by a mercy from Us and for an enjoyment until some time, in other words, they can only be saved by Our showing them mercy and Our permitting them to enjoy those pleasures of theirs until their terms [of life] are concluded.
verses.romanUrdu: Bas hamari rehmat hi hai jo inhein paar lagati aur ek waqt e khaas tak zindagi se mutamatta (enjoyment) honay ka mauqa deti hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوۡا مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon
verses.saheeh: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
verses.khattab: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”
verses.jalalayn: And when it is said to them, ‘Beware of that which is before you, of the chastisement of this world, as [it is said] to others, and that which is behind you, of the chastisement of the Hereafter, that perhaps you might find mercy’, they turn away [in aversion].
verses.romanUrdu: In logon se jab kaha jaata hai ke bacho us anjaam se jo tumhare aagey aa raha hai aur tumhare peechey guzar chukka hai, shayad ke tumpar reham kiya jaye (to yeh suni an suni kar jatey hain)

verses.uthmani: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
verses.saheeh: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
verses.khattab: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it
verses.jalalayn: And never did a sign of the signs of their Lord come to them, but that they turned away from it.
verses.romanUrdu: Inke saamne inke Rubb ki aayat(nishani) mein se jo aayat(nishani) bhi aati hai yeh iski taraf iltifaat nahin karte

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ ۙ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا اَنُطۡعِمُ مَنۡ لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ اَطۡعَمَهٗٓ ۖ اِنۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen
verses.saheeh: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
verses.khattab: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”
verses.jalalayn: And when it is said, that is, [when] the poor ones from among the Companions [of the Prophet] say, to them: ‘Expend, on us, of what God has provided you’, of wealth, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, in mockery of them: ‘Are we to feed those whom, if God willed, He would feed?, as you are wont to believe? You, in saying this to us, together with this believe of yours, are only in manifest error!’ — as an explicit declaration of their disbelief this [statement] is very effective [in the way that it has been expressed].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab insey kaha jaata hai ke Allah ne jo rizq tumhein ata kiya hai usmein se kuch Allah ki raah mein bhi kharch karo to yeh log jinhon ne kufr kiya hai iman laney walon ko jawab dete hain “ kya hum unko khilayein jinhein agar Allah chahta to khud khila deta? Tum to bilkul hi behak gaye ho”

verses.uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
verses.saheeh: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.khattab: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
verses.jalalayn: And they say, ‘When will this promise, of resurrection, be [fulfilled], if you are being truthful?’, therein.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log kehte hain ke “yeh qayamat ki dhamki aakhir kab poori hogi? Batao agar tum sacche ho”

verses.uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
verses.indopak: مَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَاۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon
verses.saheeh: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
verses.khattab: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes
verses.jalalayn: God, exalted be He, says: They await but a single Cry, namely [the cry of] Isrāfīl’s First Blast, that will seize them while they are disputing (read yakhassimūna, which is actually yakhtasimūna, where the vowel of the tā’ has been moved to the khā’ and it [the tā’] has been assimilated with the sād, in other words: while they are oblivious to it, busily engaged in disputes, concluding bargains, eating and drinking and so on; a variant reading has yakhsimūna similar [in pattern] to yadribūna, in which case the meaning is: while they dispute with one another).
verses.romanUrdu: Dar-asal yeh jis cheez ki raah takk rahey hain woh bas ek dhamaka hai jo yakayak inhein ain us halat mein dhar lega jab yeh (apne dunyavi maamlaat mein) jhagad rahey hongey

verses.uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ تَوۡصِيَةً وَّلَاۤ اِلٰٓى اَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon
verses.saheeh: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
verses.khattab: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people
verses.jalalayn: Then they will not be able to make any testament, that is, to make a bequest, nor will they return to their folk, from their markets and their businesses, rather they will die then and there.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us waqt yeh wasiyat tak na kar sakenge, na apne gharon ko palat sakenge

verses.uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّوۡرِ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ يَنۡسِلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon
verses.saheeh: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
verses.khattab: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord
verses.jalalayn: And the Trumpet is blown — this is the Horn — at the second Blast for the Resurrection [to take place]; between the two Blasts is an interval of forty years; and lo! they, those interred, will be scrambling out of their graves towards their Lord, emerging therefrom hurriedly.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir ek soor (trumpet) phoonka jayega aur yakayak ye apne Rubb ke huzur pesh honay ke liye apni qabaron se nikal padenge

verses.uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.indopak: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۡۢ بَعَثَنَا مِنۡ مَّرۡقَدِنَا ۘ هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon
verses.saheeh: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
verses.khattab: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”
verses.jalalayn: They, the disbelievers among them, will say, ‘O (yā is for calling attention [to something]) woe to us! (waylanā means halākanā, ‘[O] our destruction!’, and it is a verbal noun which has no [regular] verbal conjugation) Who has raised us from our place of sleep?, [they say this] because they will have been asleep in the interval between the two blasts and will not have been punished [yet]. This, that is, [this] raising, is that which the Compassionate One had promised and, regarding which, the messengers had spoken the truth’: they affirm [this truth] when such affirmation is no longer of any benefit to them — but it is also said that this is said to them.
verses.romanUrdu: Ghabra kar kahenge : “Arey, yeh kisne humein hamari khwab-gaah se utha khada kiya?” Yeh wahi cheez hai jiska khuda e rehman ne wada kiya tha aur Rasoolon ki baat sacchi thi”

verses.uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon
verses.saheeh: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
verses.khattab: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us
verses.jalalayn: It is but a single Cry, and, behold, they will all be arraigned before Us!
verses.romanUrdu: Ek hi zoar ki aawaz hogi aur sab ke sab hamare saamne haazir kardiye jayenge

verses.uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيۡـــًٔا وَّلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
verses.saheeh: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
verses.khattab: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do
verses.jalalayn: So today no soul shall be wronged in any way, and you shall not be requited, except, the requital of, what you used to do.
verses.romanUrdu: Aaj kisi par zarra barabar zulm na kiya jayega aur tumhein waisa hi badla diya jayega jaise amal tum karte rahe thay

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَـنَّةِ الۡيَوۡمَ فِىۡ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon
verses.saheeh: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
verses.khattab: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves
verses.jalalayn: Indeed today the inhabitants of Paradise are busy (read fī shughlin or fī shughulin), [oblivious] to what the inhabitants of the Fire are suffering, [busy] delighting in pleasures such as deflowering virgins — not busy with anything wearisome, as there is no toil in Paradise — rejoicing, blissful (fākihūna is a second predicate of inna, the first being fī shugulin, ‘busy’);
verses.romanUrdu: Aaj jannati log mazey karne mein mashgul hain

verses.uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.indopak: هُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُهُمۡ فِىۡ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَى الۡاَرَآٮِٕكِ مُتَّكِـــُٔوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon
verses.saheeh: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
verses.khattab: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches
verses.jalalayn: they (hum, the subject) and their spouses, beneath the shade (zilāl is the plural of zulla or zill, and is the predicate) in other words, no [blinding] sunlight affects them, reclining upon (muttaki’ūna is a second predicate, connected to ‘alā, ‘upon’) couches (arā’ik is the plural of arīka, which is a bed inside a curtained canopy, or the bedding therein).
verses.romanUrdu: Woh aur unki biwiyan ghanay saayon (shades) mein hain masnadon par takiye lagaye huey

verses.uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
verses.indopak: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّلَهُمۡ مَّا يَدَّعُوۡنَ ۖ ۚ
verses.transliteration: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon
verses.saheeh: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
verses.khattab: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire
verses.jalalayn: They have fruits therein and, therein, they have whatever they call for, [whatever] they wish for.
verses.romanUrdu: Har qisam ki lazeez cheezein khane peene ko unke liye wahan maujood hain, jo kuch woh talab karein unke liye haazir hai

verses.uthmani: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
verses.indopak: سَلٰمٌ قَوۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيۡمٍ
verses.transliteration: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem
verses.saheeh: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
verses.khattab: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord
verses.jalalayn: “Peace!” (salāmun is a subject) — the word (qawlan is its predicate), that is, [peace] by way of a word, from a Lord [Who is] Merciful, to them, in other words, He says to them, ‘Peace be on you!’
verses.romanUrdu: Rubb e Raheem ki taraf se unko salaam kaha gaya hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَامۡتَازُوا الۡيَوۡمَ اَيُّهَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon
verses.saheeh: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
verses.khattab: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O wicked ones
verses.jalalayn: And, He says: ‘Stand apart, O you sinners, on this day!, in other words, separate yourselves from the believers — [said to them] upon their mingling with the latter.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aey mujrimon, aaj tum chatt kar alag ho jao

verses.uthmani: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.indopak: اَلَمۡ اَعۡهَدۡ اِلَيۡكُمۡ يٰبَنِىۡۤ اٰدَمَ اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوا الشَّيۡطٰنَ ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَـكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
verses.saheeh: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
verses.khattab: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy
verses.jalalayn: Did I not charge you, command you, O children of Adam, by the tongues of My messengers, that you should not worship Satan, [that you should] not obey him; truly he is a manifest enemy to you, one whose enmity is evident,
verses.romanUrdu: Adam ke bacchon, kya maine tumko hidayat na ki thai ke shaytaan ki bandagi na karo, woh tumhara khula dushman hai

verses.uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَّاَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡنِىۡ ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
verses.saheeh: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
verses.khattab: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path
verses.jalalayn: and that [you should] worship Me, [and that you should] affirm My Oneness and obey Me — that is the straight path?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur meri hi bandagi karo, yeh seedha raasta hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدۡ اَضَلَّ مِنۡكُمۡ جِبِلًّا كَثِيۡرًا ؕ اَفَلَمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
verses.saheeh: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
verses.khattab: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense
verses.jalalayn: For verily he has led astray from among you many a creature (jibillan is the plural of jabīl, similar [in pattern] to qadīm, ‘old’; a variant reading has jubulan). Did you not use to comprehend?, his enmity and his misguidance, or the chastisements that befell them and so believe? And it will be said to them in the Hereafter:
verses.romanUrdu: Magar iske bawajood usne tum mein se ek giroh-e-kaseer (great multitude of you) ko gumraah kardiya, kya tum aqal nahin rakhte thay

verses.uthmani: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.indopak: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon
verses.saheeh: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
verses.khattab: This is the Hell you were warned of
verses.jalalayn: This is Hell, which you were promised!
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh wahi jahannum hai jissey tumko daraya jata raha tha

verses.uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.indopak: اِصۡلَوۡهَا الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
verses.saheeh: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
verses.khattab: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”
verses.jalalayn: Burn therein today [as chastisement] for that which you used to reject!’
verses.romanUrdu: Jo kufr tum duniya mein karte rahey ho uski padaish mein ab iska indhan (fuel) bano

verses.uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.indopak: اَلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلٰٓى اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَاۤ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ اَرۡجُلُهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
verses.saheeh: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
verses.khattab: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit
verses.jalalayn: Today We shall seal up their mouths, namely, [the mouths of] the disbelievers for their saying: By God, our Lord, we were never idolaters!’ [Q. 6:23]; and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness, as will other [parts of their bodies] concerning what they used to earn, and so each limb will speak of that [sinful action] which issued from it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aaj hum inke mooh bandh kiye detey hain, inke haath humse bolenge aur inke paon gawahi denge ke yeh duniya mein kya kamayi karte rahey hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَـطَمَسۡنَا عَلٰٓى اَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَاسۡتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰى يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon
verses.saheeh: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
verses.khattab: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see
verses.jalalayn: And had We willed We would have obliterated their eyesight, We would have rendered them blind by obliterating them, then, they [would have tried to] advance towards the path, to be on their way as usual, but how would they have seen?, then. In other words, they would not have been to see.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum chahein to inki aankhein moond dein(obliterated their eyes), phir yeh raastey ki taraf lapak kar dekhein, kahan se inhein raasta sujhayi dega

verses.uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰى مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مُضِيًّا وَّلَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon
verses.saheeh: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
verses.khattab: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back
verses.jalalayn: And had We willed We would have transformed them, [into] apes or swine or stones, in their place (makānatihim, variant reading has makānātihim, the plural of makāna, meaning makān, in other words ‘in their dwellings’); then they would have neither been able to go ahead nor to return, in other words, they would not then be able to come and go.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum chahein to inhein inki jagah hi par is taraf maskh (transform) karke rakh dein ke yeh na aagey chal sakein na peechey palat sakein

verses.uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَنۡ نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُـنَكِّسۡهُ فِى الۡخَـلۡقِ ؕ اَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon
verses.saheeh: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
verses.khattab: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand
verses.jalalayn: And whomever We give long life, by prolonging his term [of life], We cause him to regress (nankushu; a variant reading has [2nd verbal form] nunakkishu, derived from al-tankīs) in creation, that is, in terms of his physical form, so that after having enjoyed strength and youth, he becomes feeble and decrepit. Will they then not understand?, that One Who is able to effect such [a state] — with which they are familiar — is also able to resurrect, that they might then become believers? (a variant reading [for ya‘qilūna, ‘they understand’] has [the second person plural] ta‘qilūna, ‘you understand’).
verses.romanUrdu: Jis shaks ko hum lambi umar dete hain iski saakht ko hum ulat hi dete hain (we reverse in creation), kya (yeh halaat dekh kar) inhein aqal nahin aati

verses.uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنٰهُ الشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۡۢبَغِىۡ لَهٗ ؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ وَّقُرۡاٰنٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen
verses.saheeh: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
verses.khattab: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran
verses.jalalayn: And We did not teach him, that is, the Prophet, poetry — this was [revealed] to refute their saying, ‘This Qur'an that he has brought is but poetry!’ — nor is it, poetry, seemly, [nor is it] facilitated, for him. It — that which he has brought — is just Remembrance, an admonition, and a Qur'an that clarifies, that manifests [God’s] rulings and other matters;
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is (Nabi) ko sher nahin sikhaya hai aur na shayari isko zeib hi deti hai, yeh to ek naseehat hai aur saaf padhi janey wali kitaab

verses.uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.indopak: لِّيُنۡذِرَ مَنۡ كَانَ حَيًّا وَّيَحِقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen
verses.saheeh: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
verses.khattab: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers
verses.jalalayn: that he may warn (li-yundhira; or read li-tundhira, ‘that you may warn’), therewith, whoever is alive, able to comprehend what is being said to him — and such are the believers — and that the Word, of chastisement [from God], may be fulfilled against the disbelievers, who are like the dead, unable to comprehend what is said to them.
verses.romanUrdu: Taa-ke woh har us shaks ko khabardar karde jo zinda ho aur inkar karne walon par hujjat qayam ho jaye

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡنَاۤ اَنۡعَامًا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مٰلِكُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
verses.saheeh: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
verses.khattab: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control
verses.jalalayn: Or, have they not seen, have they [not] realised (the interrogative is meant as an affirmative, and the wāw inserted therein [in a-wa-lam] is for supplementation) that We have created for them, and for all human beings, of what Our hands worked, [of] what We have made without any partner or helper, cattle, namely, camels, cows and sheep, so that they are their owners?, masters [controlling them].
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh log dekhte nahin hain ke humne apne haathon ki banayi hui cheezon mein se inke liye maweshi paida kiye aur ab yeh inke maalik hain

verses.uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَذَلَّـلۡنٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوۡبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon
verses.saheeh: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
verses.khattab: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others
verses.jalalayn: And We have subdued, We have disposed, these [cattle] for them, so that some of them provide rides for them and some of them they eat.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne unhein is tarah inke bas mein kardiya hai ke unmein se kisi par yeh sawaar hotey hain, kisika yeh gosht khate hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon
verses.saheeh: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
verses.khattab: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks
verses.jalalayn: And there are other benefits for them therein, such as their wool, fur and hairs, and drinks, [made] from their milk (mashārib is the plural of mashrab meaning shurb, ‘a drink’; or [what is meant is] the place [from which the drink issues]). Will they not then give thanks?, to the One Who has bestowed these graces upon them and so become believers? In other words, they do not do [any of] this.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unke andar inke liye tarah tarah ke fawaid (benefits) aur mashrubaat (drinks) hain phir kya yeh shukar guzar nahin hotay

verses.uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon
verses.saheeh: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
verses.khattab: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺
verses.jalalayn: And they have taken besides God, in other words, other than Him, [other] gods, idols, which they worship, that perhaps they might be helped, protected against God’s chastisement by their gods’ interceding for them, as they are wont to claim.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh sabkuch hotey huey inhon ne Allah ke siwa dusre khuda bana liye hain aur yeh umeed rakhte hain ke inki madad ki jayegi

verses.uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ ۙ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّحۡضَرُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon
verses.saheeh: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
verses.khattab: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards
verses.jalalayn: They, their gods, cannot help them — they are being treated as [though they were] rational beings — and they, their idol gods, are their host, as they claim, their supporters, ever-present, [but] in the Fire, together with them.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh inki koi madad nahin kar sakte balke yeh log ultey unke liye hazir-baash lashkar (army in waiting ) baney huey hain

verses.uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَا يَحۡزُنۡكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡ ۘ اِنَّا نَـعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
verses.saheeh: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
verses.khattab: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal
verses.jalalayn: So do not be grieved by their remarks, to you, that you have not been sent [by God] and otherwise. Assuredly We know what they conceal and what they proclaim, in this respect and otherwise, and We will requite them accordingly.
verses.romanUrdu: Accha, jo baatein yeh bana rahey hain woh tumhein ranjeeda na karein, inki chupi aur khuli sab baaton ko hum jaante hain

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيۡمٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
verses.saheeh: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
verses.khattab: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺
verses.jalalayn: Or has man — namely, [the like of] al-‘Āsī b. Wā’il — not seen, [has he not] realised, that We created him from a drop, of sperm [and so on in stages] until We made him powerful and strong. Then lo! he is an open adversary, severely antagonistic towards Us, [openly] making this manifest by his denial of resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Insaan dekhta nahin hai ke humne usey nutfe(sperm drop) se paida kiya aur phir woh sareeh jhagdalu bankar khada ho gaya

verses.uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَضَرَبَ لَـنَا مَثَلًا وَّ نَسِىَ خَلۡقَهٗ ؕ قَالَ مَنۡ يُّحۡىِ الۡعِظَامَ وَهِىَ رَمِيۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem
verses.saheeh: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
verses.khattab: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”
verses.jalalayn: And he strikes for Us a similitude, in this respect, and forgets [the manner of] his creation, from a sperm-drop, a thing more curious than his similitude; he says, ‘Who will revive the bones when they are rot?’, in other words, [when they have become] withered (He does not say ramīmatun, ‘decayed’, because it [ramīmun, ‘rot’] is a noun and not an adjective). It is reported that he [al-‘Āsī] took some withered bones and crushed them into pieces and said to the Prophet (s), ‘Do you think that God can revive these [bones] after they have decayed and become rot?’ And so the Prophet (s) said, ‘Yes indeed! And He will also throw you into the Fire’.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab woh humpar misalein chaspan karta hai aur apni paidaish ko bhool jaata hai , kehta hai “kaun in haddiyon ko zinda karega jabke yeh boseeda (rotten) ho chuki hon?”

verses.uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.indopak: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيۡهَا الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡشَاَهَاۤ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيۡمُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem
verses.saheeh: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being
verses.jalalayn: Say: ‘He will revive them Who originated them the first time, and He is Knower of all creation, [of every single] creature, generally and in detail, before and after it has been created —
verses.romanUrdu: Ussey kaho,inhein wahi zinda karega jisne pehle inhein paida kiya tha, aur woh takhleeq (creation) ka har kaam jaanta hai

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verses.indopak: اۨلَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الۡاَخۡضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَاۤ اَنۡـتُمۡ مِّنۡهُ تُوۡقِدُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon
verses.saheeh: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
verses.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them
verses.jalalayn: He Who has made for you, and for all human beings, fire from the green tree, namely, [from] the markh and ‘afār [variety], or [from] all trees, except for the jujube (‘unnāb), and, behold, from it you kindle’, [from it] you strike fire: this is proof of the power [of God] to resurrect, for in this [example of the green tree] He has combined [the elements of] water, fire and wood; but neither the water extinguishes the fire, nor does the fire ignite the wood.
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi jisne tumhare liye harey bharey (green) darakht se aag paida kardi aur tum ussey apne chuleh (stoves) roshan karte ho

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَيۡسَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓى اَنۡ يَّخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۡ ؕ بَلٰی وَهُوَ الۡخَـلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.transliteration: Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem
verses.saheeh: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
verses.khattab: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing
verses.jalalayn: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, in all their immensity, able to create the like of them?, namely, human beings, in all their minuteness? Yes indeed, He is able to do this — God Himself replies here. And He is the Creator (khallāq means Creator of many things), the Knower, of all things.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya woh jisne aasmaano aur zameen ko paida kiya ispar qadir nahin hai ke in jaison ko paida kar sakey? Kyun nahin, jabke woh maahir khallaq (superb creator) hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.indopak: اِنَّمَاۤ اَمۡرُهٗۤ اِذَاۤ اَرَادَ شَیْـًٔـا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ
verses.transliteration: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon
verses.saheeh: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.khattab: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is
verses.jalalayn: His command, His affair, when He wills a thing, that is, [when He will] to create something, is just to say to it ‘Be’, and it is (a variant reading [for fa-yakūnu] has fa-yakūna, as a supplement to yaqūla, ‘to say’).
verses.romanUrdu: Woh to jab kisi cheez ka irada karta hai to uska kaam bas yeh hai ke usey hukum de ke hoja aur woh jo jati hai

verses.uthmani: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: فَسُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَـكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon
verses.saheeh: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.khattab: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned
verses.jalalayn: So glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion of all things (malakūt means mulk: the wāw and tā’ have been added for hyperbole) and to Whom you will be returned, restored, in the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Paak hai woh jiske haath mein har cheez ka mukammal iqtedar (full control) hai, aur usi ki taraf tum paltaye janey waale ho
